**Allowed origins:** `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Where configured:** `worker\src\index.ts` — in the `cors()` middleware call, inside the `origin` callback function (passed to `app.use('*', cors({...}))`).

**To add a new custom domain:** Edit that `origin` function and add a check (e.g. `origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com'` or an `.endsWith('.your-domain.com')` check) to the `if` condition before `return origin;`. Note: Hono's `cors()` treats plain string-array entries as exact-match only — wildcards require this function form, which is why it's implemented this way (see `docs\DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4 "CORS").
